payload.title: Live projection delta-push over the sync gateway
payload.description:
Apps cannot use server-computed projections as a LIVE data source. Two gaps, both server-only — the wire + TS client are ALREADY done:
- FrameKind.ProjectionDelta exists: packages/protocol/src/frame.ts:34,158,165,191
- @frick/core already SUBSCRIBES (packages/core/src/runtime.ts:463 & :886, #sendSubscribe({kind:'projection',name})) and already HANDLES incoming deltas (runtime.ts:707-708). useProjection() works client-side today.

CURRENT SERVER STATE:
- store.projections registry is created EMPTY (apps/server/src/server.ts:415 createFrickProjectionRegistry; attached :581) and only exposed over HTTP read (GET /projections/:name, list, rebuild — server.ts:938,1673,1683,3847+).
- The registry already has a delta listener hook (apps/server/src/projections/registry.ts:209 setDeltaListener + ProjectionDeltaNotice) but NOTHING calls it.
- ServerOptions has NO projections field, so apps can't register projections at all.
- The gateway (apps/server/src/sync/gateway.ts) has NO 'projection' subscribe/broadcast handling.

WORK:
A) App registration: add ServerOptions.projections?: readonly FrickProjection[] (and/or accept via the project/apps module); register each into store.projections at boot.
B) Gateway push: handle the client's existing 'projection' subscribe frame — track per-connection projection subscriptions (mirror the object/stream subscribe path), deliver an INITIAL SNAPSHOT (current projection rows) on subscribe, and wire store.projections.setDeltaListener(notice => fan a ProjectionDelta frame out to connections subscribed to notice.projection).
C) Tenant-scope the fan-out (only same-tenant subscribers).

FOLLOW-UP (separate ticket): Swift/Kotlin SDK parity for projection subscribe+apply.

WHY: lets the server compute a view once (dashboard KPIs, WO queue, schedule board, tech utilization, customer LTV) and push deltas, instead of every client recomputing from raw objects. Unblocks aquarius-os AQ-23 / AQ-24.

ACCEPTANCE: app registers a projection; a @frick/core client calling client.projection(name) gets an initial snapshot then live tenant-scoped deltas as source objects/streams change; pnpm test + typecheck + verify:generated green; docs (docs/operations.md projections note) + CHANGELOG updated.
